data_source: public independent GitHub repository, official NFL Combine measurements derived from NFL API
limitations: Both CSV and Parquet metadata contain 6568 records; third-party README declares 6883, i.e. an inconsistent documentation count; reason unknown
2021 absent from source years; cannot infer a contiguous 2006-2026 population
descriptive summaries by position only; no player-to-match outcome join, no prediction, no causal inference
source repository does not provide verified authorization for redistributing raw records; aggregated metrics only
2021 in-person Combine workouts were canceled due to COVID; NFL official report confirms pro days instead; no 2021 Combine measurements imputed
draft_grade is a scouting grade that may itself incorporate athletic tests; association cannot be interpreted as an independent prediction of career performance
tests: 11/11 PASS, offline Python fixtures; real data aggregated independently via connected GitHub read

source_cross_format_reconciliation.parquet_metadata_method: Decode GitHub Base64 Parquet raw bytes, verify PAR1 magic, footer length, parse Thrift compact FileMetaData field 3 num_rows; confirmed footer terminates exactly at expected metadata boundary

pilot_draft_grade_association.outcome: draft_grade, scouting draft grade recorded in same data source, not an independent NFL match outcome
pilot_draft_grade_association.method: Pearson correlation after subtracting means within (year,position_group) strata
pilot_draft_grade_association.negative_control: 300 deterministic within-stratum permutations of draft_grade, 0 reaching absolute observed r
pilot_draft_grade_association.note: Monte Carlo corrected two-sided p-value is minimum resolution at 300 permutations; this is not an upper confidence bound and not an NFL-match predictive validation.
pilot_draft_grade_association.tests: 10/10 PASS on offline Python synthetic fixtures; 300 permutations evaluated via JS on GitHub-connected real CSV. Python real-source rerun UNVERIFIED.
